content:
Pranav: FYI I opened a small PR to unify the quant profile examples across optimize toolkit pages. It's mostly moving the short-seq/long-seq examples under a single qprofile and fixing one failing link. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321

Elaine: Thanks — saw the diff. Two quick asks: 1) the Go SDK snippet still uses the old `QuantProfile.ShortSeq` name, can you update to the new `QuantProfiles.short_sequence` field, and 2) small wording nit in the caching section (prefix -> prefix/KV)

Pranav: Yep will do. On the Go snippet, thinking something like:

```go
// apply short-seq quant profile
opt := optimize.NewOptions()
opt.QuantProfile = optimize.QuantProfiles.ShortSequence()
client.ApplyOptions(opt)
```

Sam: minor suggestion — use the builder pattern we adopted elsewhere for clarity:

```go
opt := optimize.NewOptions().WithQuantProfile(optimize.QuantProfiles.ShortSequence())
client.ApplyOptions(opt)
```

Sam: also found a dead internal link in the Kv-prefetch doc, flagged it in the PR comments, docs-bot should autopatch the redirect but we prefer a real content fix.

docs-bot: Link check report: 1 broken internal link (docs/optimize/kv-prefetch.md#prefetch-policy). Recommended action: replace anchor with #kv-prefetch-policy or update target doc.

Pranav: I'll push the Go snippet change + wording fix in the next hour and add a short migration note for customers that used the old field name. Pinging @Elaine for quick review when done.

Elaine: Sounds good. If you can also add a one-line example for the Python SDK (mirror the Go builder pattern) that'd be helpful for users skimming for snippets. Otherwise I'm happy to approve after your update. :thumbsup:

Pranav: Will add Python example too. Draft patch will include:
- Go builder snippet
- Python snippet parity
- fixed anchor in kv-prefetch.md
- CHANGELOG entry under docs/optimize/updates.md

Sam: Awesome. If you want me to sanity-check the link anchor I can do a quick pass after you push.

Pranav: Thanks — marking this as in-progress, will update thread when pushed.
